edit.statement: 'Has type species' is functional: every zoological genus has exactly one type species.

notes: Real: under the ICZN (Article 67.1) the name-bearing type of a nominal genus is a single nominal species, its type species; the type species of Panthera is Panthera pardus (Felis pardus Linnaeus, 1758). A nomenclature rule rarely spelled out. Locality reference is the logical answer; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer.
